deleted: Sub-status deleted. Tasks fell back to the parent status.
deleteMsg: Deleting « {{name}} » removes it everywhere: tasks that carry it fall back to the parent status.
parentLocked: The parent status cannot be changed after creation — delete and recreate instead.
colorNone: No color — the parent status color is used.
notifyHint: When a task enters this sub-status, the selected teams (all members) and people get an email and a Teams card. The person who moved the task is not notified.
scopeHint: Leave all unchecked to make the sub-status available on every project.
